newsitem.title: CHINA: KING FOOK YEARLY PROFIT RISES 27.24 PCT.
newsitem.headline: KING FOOK YEARLY PROFIT RISES 27.24 PCT.

text.p: Company name King Fook Holdings Ltd
NOTE - King Fook is a retailer of jewellery, watches and gold ornaments and engages in bullion trading and foreign exchange services.

The company proposed a bonus issue of one 1999 warrant for every five shares held. The warrants will entitle its holders to subscribe for shares of the company at a price of HK$0.80 per share (subject to adjustment) at any time on or after the date of issue and expire on March 31, 1999.

The exceptional item for the current year represents the write down in the carrying value of fixed assets of a subsidiary in the People's Republic of China resulting from the cessation of operations of the subsidiary.
Total dividend for year is 4.5 H.K. cents (including interim dividend of one cent) vs four cents.
